title: AI Agent Trace Event
description: A single normalized event from an AI agent's runtime execution trace. Designed to be a common, minimal target format that OpenTelemetry spans, LangSmith runs, AgentOps sessions, and MCP tool-call logs can all be mapped down to, so downstream tools (compliance documentation, monitoring, audits) don't need a separate parser per source.

event.description: The kind of thing that happened.

id.description: A unique identifier for this event, stable enough to be cited as evidence (e.g. in generated documentation).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

session_id.description: Identifier grouping this event with others from the same agent run/session, if applicable.

tool.description: Name of the tool invoked. Required when event is 'tool_call'.

status.description: Outcome of a tool_call or model_call.

actor.description: Identifier (e.g. email) of the human involved. Required when event is 'human_intervention'.

action.description: What the human did, e.g. 'approved', 'rejected', 'overrode'. Used with human_intervention.

message.description: Human-readable detail, e.g. an error message.

metadata.description: Free-form additional context that doesn't fit the fields above.
